svg.aria-label: I'm Yassir, 22, from Morocco. I'm doing my engineering degree in AI at ENSA Al Hoceima and graduating in 2027. Everything is going according to plan. Most of my time goes into making LLMs actually useful: fine-tuning them, plugging them into real documents, and teaching them to say "I don't know" instead of casting Kyōka Suigetsu on you. When I get tired of GPUs, I go bother an ESP32.
svg.text: // yōkoso, watashi no GitHub e · welcome to my GitHub
I'm Yassir, 22, from Morocco. I'm doing my engineering degree in AI at ENSA Al Hoceima and
graduating in 2027. Everything is going according to plan.
Most of my time goes into making LLMs actually useful: fine-tuning them, plugging them into real
documents, and teaching them to say "I don't know" instead of casting Kyōka Suigetsu on you. When
I get tired of GPUs, I go bother an ESP32.

g.text: My RAG pipelines cite their sources. Unlike Aizen, they won't spend 100 years lying to you.
I've lost more nights to Docker networking than I'd like to admit. That part was not in the plan.
You say your bug is impossible to fix? Don't use such strong words. It makes you look weak.
Arabic, French and English are at Bankai level. Chinese and German are still in Shikai.
Powered by Moroccan mint tea. Yes, way too much sugar.
